en.name: Grindelwald
en.ability: Each night* choose a dead player, you may use their ability. If The Dark Lord was to die, you become the new Dark Lord and deaths are arbitrary. [-1 Outsider]

revisions.v1: Each night* choose a dead player, you may use their ability. If The Dark Lord was to die, you become the new Dark Lord and deaths are arbitrary. [-1 Outsider]

en.flavor: Magic blooms... only in rare souls. Still, we must skulk in shadows. But the old ways serve us no longer.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake and ask them to choose a dead player
